threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 243 -> 305 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow -20 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -326 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The RBI repo rate hike is expected to impact affordable and mid-income housing demand.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: Management noted that luxury buyers are not driven by loan rates, but acknowledged broader market uncertainty.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W23/O28/T19), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 70 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
